description:
## Verified problem

The fz-kdt.163 current-base structural ownership audit found NativeBodyOrigin::Continuation helpers emitted into NativeProgram even though no completed native IR refers to them. Across the deterministic 502-fixture sharing census, 59 owned-body occurrences across fixed-point index passes were unreachable from their executable or clause roots. Every audited missing function was a generated __branch_N or __resume_N helper. An exhaustive whole-corpus assertion proved that each had zero Call, TailCall, CallClosure, or ReceiveMatched control edges; zero MakeFnRef, MakeClosure, or ClosureCapture construction references; and no publication through NativeProgram.entry, executable_entries, or callable-boundary identity, wrapper, or member targets. They are genuinely dead native functions, not indirect reachability or mis-owned sharing metadata.

## Goal

Delete unreachable native branch and resume functions at the ownership boundary that emits them so NativeProgram contains only functions reachable from its published roots and construction words. This is removal work: do not merely add a census, tolerate the dead inventory, or hide it with a sharing exception.

## Ownership model and strategy

NativeProgram publication is the authority after native lowering. Function roots are NativeProgram.entry, every executable_entries FnId, and callable-boundary wrapper functions and member targets. Construction identity_fn values are separately published code words, not module functions: MakeFnRef, MakeClosure, and ClosureCapture identities must resolve uniquely through NativeCallableBoundary to those actual function roots. Direct control references and continuation owners must resolve to module functions. Reachability then closes over every direct CPS control edge in Call, TailCall, CallClosure continuations, and ReceiveMatched guard, body, and after edges.

NativeLowerer currently predeclares every non-clause BackendEntry in entry_fn_ids and unconditionally builds them in lower_entry_helpers. The actual emitter already omits incoming edges: NoReturn emits a tail call without its Deliver destination, and settled dispatch visits only actual graph outcomes. Replace eager helper inventory with typed demand-driven allocation and a deduplicated worklist fed at actual function-reference emission; drain transitive requests after published clause/executable roots. This prevents helper body/fact/function construction instead of performing native DCE or maintaining a second backend reachability model. Test recursive/repeated requests for exactly-once emission.

Signal and TDD: first pin dead branch and resume emission with focused production-path tests. Extend the existing ignored native sharing census using a test-only complete reference invariant and per-fixture function/body/native-byte totals. Capture a current pre-fix baseline on HEAD 537280e35 before production edits; the historical 502-fixture audit and older checked-in 474-resolved report are not interchangeable baselines. After the fix require zero dead functions and attribute direct deletion separately from newly possible sibling sharing. Existing raw before_sharing and define_function events supply evidence without new runtime observation hooks. Root holds immutable representative baseline /tmp/fz-tfn18-final.YsnYkB and deterministic repeat /tmp/fz-tfn18-final-repeat.bmDz7F.

Keep module.fns, module.fn_idx, NativeProgram.bodies, continuation owners, executable_entries, callable boundaries, direct controls, and construction words consistent by construction. Remove all temporary audit instrumentation and obsolete allocation/counting machinery made unnecessary by the deletion.

## Acceptance

- Focused RED tests reproduce at least one dead branch and one dead resume helper before the fix, then GREEN proves neither helper is emitted.
- Every retained native function is reachable from a published root or construction word through the complete reference model above; no dangling function reference or continuation owner remains.
- The deterministic corpus reports zero unreachable native functions and strictly fewer NativeBody and module function records than the pre-ticket baseline, with the exact body and native-byte reduction recorded.
- Interpreter, JIT, AOT, diagnostics, semantic executable inventory, callable construction identity, recursive-search telemetry, and canonical artifacts remain unchanged except for removal of dead native code.
- No new permanent observation hook or duplicate reachability model remains unless it is the smallest runtime-free invariant check at the authoritative boundary.
- The complete fixture matrix, fz2_cli, full library tests, formatting, strict all-target/all-feature clippy, and warnings-as-errors gates pass.

## Current TDD evidence

On unchanged production HEAD 537280e35, native_dispatch_does_not_emit_unselected_branch_helpers fails with two unreachable branch helpers from fixtures2/00152_case_wildcard_unreachable.fz; native_no_return_call_does_not_emit_delivery_resume fails with an unreachable main resume for non-tail panic(:done) followed by 42. Both fail the typed complete reference invariant; helper names are diagnostics only. Full current-baseline census completed before production changes (handle90828 polled terminal exit0, 1 passed). Log /tmp/fz-tfn27-baseline-census.log SHA256 61d1d2939410a50e5dc0eb87850e7c920898be88c7b3f616dc9656d00cfb6511: 511 candidates, 475 resolved, 473 paired codegen successes, 5771 semantic executable entries, 118 constructions before/after sharing. Pre-sharing bodies/functions15816 and native bytes3338000; post-sharing bodies/functions15527 and bytes3281840. Both pre/post sharing contain53 unreachable functions. These are actual function counts, not historical59 repeated ownership-index occurrences. Sharing work208 passes,18688 indexed bodies,17961 graph-owned bodies,6728 graph comparisons,6098 body comparisons. Six synthetic oracle tests pass, including malformed identities, indexes, owners and control references. The census now handles drive_root_to_dump_stage errors inside its existing panic boundary, since expected unresolved fixtures must not abort enumeration.
title: Delete unreachable native branch and resume helpers at their emitter
